description: Source file defining Express.js route handlers for user management in a backend application, including user retrieval, approval, rejection, revocation, and updating functionalities with database interactions.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Retrieve list of users, with optional filters for status, role, and search term; handles database unavailability and column existence issues.

methods.name: GET /users/requests
methods.description: Retrieve list of pending account requests for approval.

methods.name: POST /users/:userId/approve
methods.description: Approve a user account request, updating status and role, with error handling for database schema issues.

methods.name: POST /users/:userId/reject
methods.description: Reject and remove a user account request, sending notification if user was active.

methods.name: POST /users/:userId/revoke
methods.description: Revoke a user account, updating status and notifying user.

methods.name: PATCH /users/:userId
methods.description: Update user details, including email, name, role, status, and professional title.

methods.name: GET /users/:userId
methods.description: Retrieve user details by ID with permission checks and handling for missing columns.
